title: Polar form on a single-coordinate vector
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, $i<n$, and $c\in\mathbb F_2$. The polar form of $x$ and the vector supported only at coordinate $i$ with value $c$ is $c$ times the sum of the coordinates $x_j$ for $j\ne i$.
